observations.title: Discover spell scrolls
observations.player_action: Find scrolls as loot and identify their spell and level.
observations.outcome: Obtain a spell with rarity/level constraints.

observations.title: Inscription Table book building
observations.player_action: Insert an appropriate spell scroll into a spellbook at the Inscription Table; book tier limits what it accepts.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Впиши заклинание из свитка в книгу.

observations.title: Forge spell scrolls
observations.player_action: Use ink, paper and a school focus in the Scroll Forge; ink controls rarity and focus controls school.
observations.outcome: Craft spell scrolls rather than solely looting them.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Создай собственный свиток в кузнице свитков.

observations.title: Upgrade spells and books
observations.player_action: Use the Arcane Anvil to upgrade scrolls, spellbooks and school armor with appropriate components.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Улучши магический предмет на арканной наковальне.

observations.title: Imbue a sword with a spell
observations.player_action: At an Arcane Anvil, apply one spell to a supported sword; source notes scroll cannot be recovered from the imbued sword.
observations.outcome: New combat interaction with a durable commitment.
observations.review_note: Check compatibility with JEM weapons, native sword types and current version before an automatic quest.

observations.title: School-specific spell crafting
observations.player_action: Acquire appropriate magical focuses; spell schools use different material sources.
observations.outcome: Unlock chosen-school scrolls with the Scroll Forge.
